speaker: Doctor
text: Can you tell me how long you have had this rash, and whether any other symptoms like fever or joint pain have accompanied it? Also, what other health changes have you noticed recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old male. The patient presents with a rash that started last night, finding it very concerning. He does not recall being exposed to any new environmental stimuli such as detergents or plants like poison ivy. He mentions he recently started seeing a primary care provider for arthritis management and a new onset cough.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-induced hypersensitivity pneumonitis with cutaneous reaction (likely secondary to recent initiation of new arthritis medications). REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_CTA.
